name: Fugitives
metaDescription: Fugitives is a LifeLoom real-world multiplayer chase game where hunters track fugitives across a defined play area.
summary: A real-world multiplayer chase game where hunters track fugitives across a live, geofenced play area.

hero.heading: Turn the real world into the game board.
hero.description: Fugitives creates live multiplayer chase games where hunters pursue fugitives across a defined area using location, timing and movement to outplay one another.

section.heading: Run. Hunt. Outsmart.
section.description: Location-aware gameplay turns streets, parks and chosen play areas into a live pursuit.

features.title: Hunters vs fugitives
features.description: Split players into opposing roles with different objectives and ways to win.

features.title: Live location gameplay
features.description: Use player movement and map locations as part of the game itself.

features.title: Geofenced play areas
features.description: Keep each game inside a defined real-world zone.

features.title: Timed reveals and captures
features.description: Use controlled location reveals and capture rules to keep every chase moving.
